rules.round_discipline: One file per round. Claude reads the file, writes analysis into the round entry, writes plan_impact, updates current_state.last_completed_round, then stops.
rules.gate_before_plan: The output plan is not written until all 116 rounds are complete.
rules.format_for_analysis: Each round produces: (1) what the file contains, (2) key facts relevant to the goal, (3) how it affects the plan sections.
rules.early_exit: If a round's file is a verbatim duplicate of an already-analyzed file, mark status as 'duplicate — skipped' and note which round covers it.
rules.state_file_update: After each round, the state file is updated with the completed round's analysis before starting the next round.
